subject: Commitment roster check-in: MAP & close plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Cole <rachel@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Commitment roster check-in: MAP & close plan

Hi Rachel / Acme procurement team —

Quick weekly MAP checkpoint from our side. We reviewed the evaluation plan and the updated MAP (attached: MAP_v3.xlsx) with the team this morning. High-level status and decisions: 

- Evaluation window: confirmed 2-week hands-on trial (Dec 6–19).
- Pilot scope: 5 endpoints, sample dataset from Acme (anonymized) for latency and cost profiling.
- Security/compliance: we will deliver SOC 2 evidence + architecture diagram by EOD Wednesday (Dec 2).
- Commercial: draft SOW attached (SOW_draft_v1.pdf). Karthik will update pricing based on committed monthly tokens; aim to finalize this week.

Action owners we propose: 
- Marissa Cole (CS): lead eval kickoff, coordinate test dataset and success criteria — due Dec 7.
- Karthik Iyer (Solutions/AE lead): finalize SOW/pricing and provide redlines — due Dec 3.
- Ben Carter (AE): secure procurement timeline and sign-off path, coordinate DocuSign flow — due Dec 10.

Please confirm these owners and dates, and call out any procurement steps we should factor in (PO lead time, specific security artifacts beyond SOC 2). If helpful, we can hold a 30-min sync tomorrow (Dec 2) to close open items — propose 10:00am PT.

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_draft_v1.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Rachel Cole <rachel@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commitment roster check-in: MAP & close plan

Thanks Ben — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed on the demo. A few quick clarifications from procurement/ops: 

1) Evaluation window: Dec 6–19 works, but we need a short onboarding checklist (accounts, IP allowlist, sample data upload instructions) for our infra team. Can Marissa create that?

2) Procurement timelines: our internal PO process takes ~7 business days after SOW sign-off. We will need the final SOW by Dec 3 to hit our desired Dec 17 start-of-paid-service date.

3) Security artifacts: SOC 2 is necessary; we also need an encryption-at-rest confirmation and an audit log retention statement (how long logs persist and how we get them for audits). If you can attach the SOC 2 report and a short note on log retention, that will speed our security review.

Procurement contact is procurement@acme.com — they will own the PO once SOW is final.

Happy to take the 10am PT sync tomorrow if that works for everyone.

—Rachel
Director of Product Operations, Acme Corp

Date: 2026-12-02T08:58:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commitment roster check-in: MAP & close plan

Thanks Rachel — noted. Short answers and next steps: 

- Onboarding checklist: Marissa will own and deliver a one-pager (accounts + IP allowlist + data upload) by end of day Dec 2.
- SOW timing: Karthik will circulate a redlined SOW by Dec 3 morning; once Acme signs we will route DocuSign. I will work with procurement@acme.com to confirm PO deadlines.
- Security artifacts: attaching (SOC2_summary.pdf) and adding the log retention statement below; full SOC 2 report will be shared under NDA if needed.

Log retention (short): Redwood retains request-level audit logs for 180 days by default; extended retention is available as an add-on (up to 24 months) — we can include retention options in the SOW appendix. Encryption: all customer data at rest is AES-256; keys are customer-managed via KMS for Private deployments.

Consolidated action item list (owners & due dates):
- Marissa Cole: Onboarding one-pager + eval runbook — due 2026-12-02
- Karthik Iyer: Redline SOW with pricing, retention options — due 2026-12-03
- Ben Carter: Confirm PO lead time and secure DocuSign flow; start SOW routing — due 2026-12-10
- Acme (Rachel / procurement): Confirm internal PO milestone and any additional security docs required — due 2026-12-03

I'll join the 10:00am PT sync tomorrow. DocuSign link will be added to the SOW once Karthik posts the redline: https://docusign.com/link/abcdef123456

Best,
Ben

Appreciate the clarity — I have the onboarding one-pager and the eval playbook ready. Attaching eval-playbook.pdf (small stub) with the following bullets to drive the kickoff: 

- Kickoff workshop (30m): agenda = environment access, success criteria, test dataset handoff — schedule by Dec 6 morning.
- Test dataset: please drop anonymized samples to the secure S3 link we will provide; provide file schema and sample rows.
- Success metrics: latency (p95 < 150ms), token cost baseline, qualitative accuracy checks on 100 samples.

Confirming owners & next steps: 
- Marissa: deliver onboarding one-pager + secure S3 link — DONE (attached)
- Karthik: SOW redline expected this morning (will follow up)
- Ben: confirm PO path with procurement@acme.com — Ben, can you confirm when you think PO will be initiated after SOW signature?

I will also be on the 10:00am PT sync to walk through the eval playbook.

Thanks —Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
